Complete before class tomorrow.

## Read Today's Handouts

Read these handouts before class tomorrow:

- Daily Field Readiness
- Field Clothing
- Binoculars and Spotting Scopes
- Field Notebook
- Urban and Suburban Habitats.

## Set Up eBird and Merlin

Create or log into an eBird account and install the following apps on your phone:

- [eBird Mobile](https://ebird.org/about/ebird-mobile)
- [Merlin](https://merlin.allaboutbirds.org/download/)

Download the bird packs for Minnesota and North Dakota.

You do not need to fully understand the apps yet. We will spend more time learning how to use eBird and Merlin during class tomorrow.

Know your eBird username for tomorrow.

## Prepare Your Field Gear

Before going to bed tonight:

- Label your field notebook with:
  - your name
  - the course name
  - contact information (optional but recommended)
- Pack your daily field gear
- Put pencils or pens in your bag
- Charge your phone and other electronics
- Check the weather forecast and prepare clothing for tomorrow morning
- Double-check that your alarm is set

#colbreak()

## Complete Your First Personal Bird Checklist

Spend approximately 15–20 minutes observing birds near your home, apartment, dorm, neighborhood, or another nearby location.

Record the checklist in your field notebook, including:

- date
- locality
- start and end time
- species observed
- approximate number of individuals
- a few brief behavioral or identification notes

I will check this assignment tomorrow for completion.

## Learn These Common Species

Be able to recognize the following species by appearance tomorrow morning:

- Mourning Dove
- American Crow
- American Robin
- Black-capped Chickadee
- Chipping Sparrow
- Common Grackle

Focus on:

- overall appearance
- size and shape
- common habitat
- any distinctive behaviors or sounds
